tests.prompt: The checkout page crashes when I click Pay. The steps are: add an item to the cart, go to checkout, and click Pay. I am using Chrome on Windows 11.
tests.expected: The assistant should recognize a bug report, create a bug report using the provided description, steps to reproduce, and environment, then confirm successful creation and provide the returned ticket ID.
The assistant should answer only from the FAQ: estimated delivery times are shown at checkout and in the shipping confirmation email, and processing typically takes 1-2 business days before dispatch.
Because gift wrapping is not covered by the FAQ, the assistant should not invent an answer and should refer the customer to the human support line at 1-800-555-0199 (Mon-Fri).

tests.prompt: Can you help me negotiate a business partnership?
tests.expected: The assistant should explain that it cannot handle this request and refer the customer only to the human support line at 1-800-555-0199 (Mon-Fri), without inventing other contact information.
